text: The Patriots' practice squad saw some shuffling this week as the team re-signed linebacker Jose Ramirez while releasing offensive lineman Jacob Rizy, and also released punter Bryce Baringer from injured reserve—moves that come on the heels of a frustrating 30-24 Thursday night loss to the Bears in Chicago, a game where Caleb Williams outdueled Drake Maye with two touchdown passes. Film review of the loss reveals concerns that align with one of Mike Vrabel's core team identity pillars: the Patriots are struggling with turnover differential, a critical area they'll need to shore up if they want to get back on track. On the bright side, running back Rhamondre Stevenson continues to do the little things right, reaching a career high in receiving yards against Chicago and putting himself on pace for his sixth consecutive season of 100 carries, even as the offense couldn't quite overcome Williams and the Bears' attack. The college football world descends on Gillette this week as Navy and Notre Dame bring their historic rivalry to the stadium for the first time, adding another dimension to the week ahead as the Patriots look to bounce back.
